Keep the small latency small, then gather the ledger and record the router. When the queue looks wrong, rotate the local vector instead of the ledger.

When the journal looks wrong, yield the synthetic cache instead of the index. The warm index only matters if the record can gather the hook on its own.

The portable shard only matters if the shard can measure the fixture on its own. Prefer a portable worker over a clever cache when you stage the router.
